specification.title: Working Draft, Standard for Programming Language C++ (N4659)
specification.version: C++17 working draft N4659 (2017-03-21); accepted DRs named by tests separately

inventory.notes: Initial release map: one precisely qualified member-function slice, current explicit frontend capability diagnostics, and the actual cstdio frontier. This is not complete C++17 chapter or standard-library coverage. Existing supported domains without per-feature evidence rows are not reclassified as missing. Whole cb41: 2005 ordinary PASS; 655 integration PASS, four external-reference compilation FAIL, two missing-native-input ERROR. No combined green/TinyXML2 owned claim.

features.title: Non-inline non-static member functions through pointer receivers
features.scope: Bounded non-inherited/non-virtual classes: out-of-class definitions, arrow and implicit-this calls, const/non-const overloads, private access, object-before-argument evaluation and typed ABI. Twenty-three exact caller/method programs execute against independently supplied foreign object storage; a separate C++ reference provider supplies storage only. This does not qualify constructors, dot-receiver addresses, inline ODR, native pcc1, standalone projects or a private runtime. Same-source explicit G++ reference is not a production dependency. Independent ABI, two-TU and export tests are additionally recorded in the sealed cb41 qualification, not counted as 26 independent executions.

features.title: Owned C++ cstdio declarations and runtime dependency closure
features.scope: Original unmodified TinyXML2 public frontend currently stops at missing cstdio. No successful header, runtime stdio or whole-project qualification is inferred from earlier cctype/climits headers. Standard library chapter expansion remains outstanding.

diagnostics.notes: Pinned pcc/frontends/cpp/*.py at cb41: all exact cpp.unsupported.* literals and finite constructions (_FEATURES, _CHUNK_FEATURES, declarator helper arguments and explicit branch suffixes). Generic syntax gates are recorded, not a claim to exhaust all missing C++17 constructs. Only one representative emitting source per code is stored; checker should inventory all occurrences. Diagnostic-map completeness is not feature/specification completeness.
